title: Employer Benefit Charging Classes and the Charge Position
content:
Under Employer Benefit Charging, every employer that paid a claimant wages in the claim's base period holds a **charge position** on that claim: the employer's chargeable standing on the claim, which carries the notice of claim, the employer's response, the benefit charges posted from each payment and any protest or relief. Each position is placed in one of seven charge classes according to the employer's relationship to the claimant, how the employer finances benefits, and the program of the claim.

## The seven charge classes

| Charge class | Relationship to the claimant | Financing | Claim program |
|---|---|---|---|
| Separating Employer — Most Recent | Most recent employer and a base-period employer | Contributory | Regular State Unemployment Insurance, or Combined Wage Claim (CWC) |
| Base Period Employer — Proportional Share | Base-period employer that is not the most recent employer | Contributory | Regular State Unemployment Insurance |
| Continuing Part-Time Base Period Employer | Base-period employer still employing the claimant part time, as the employer reports in its separation response | Contributory | Not specified for this class |
| Combined Wage Claim Contributing Employer | Lakeland base-period employer on a combined wage claim | Contributory | Combined Wage Claim (CWC) |
| Extended Benefits State-Share Employer | Base-period employer of the claim on which Extended Benefits are paid | Contributory | Extended Benefits (EB) |
| Reimbursing Nonprofit Employer — Dollar-for-Dollar | Base-period employer | Reimbursing nonprofit | Regular State Unemployment Insurance, Combined Wage Claim (CWC) or Extended Benefits (EB) |
| Reimbursing Governmental Employer — Dollar-for-Dollar | Base-period employer | Reimbursing governmental | Regular State Unemployment Insurance, Combined Wage Claim (CWC) or Extended Benefits (EB) |

## Positions, programs and closure, by class

| Charge class | Positions one employer account may hold on one claim | Programs whose payments never open or charge a position | When a position closes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Separating Employer — Most Recent | 1 | UCFE, UCX, TRA, DUA | The claim has closed and the protest window of the last statement has passed |
| Base Period Employer — Proportional Share | 1 | UCFE, UCX, TRA, DUA | The claim has closed and the protest window of the last statement has passed |
| Continuing Part-Time Base Period Employer | 1 | UCFE, UCX, TRA, DUA | The claim has closed and the protest window of the last statement has passed |
| Combined Wage Claim Contributing Employer | 1 | UCFE, UCX, TRA, DUA | The claim has closed and the protest window of the last statement has passed |
| Extended Benefits State-Share Employer | 1 | UCFE, UCX, TRA, DUA | The claim has closed and the protest window of the last statement has passed |
| Reimbursing Nonprofit Employer — Dollar-for-Dollar | 1 | UCFE, UCX, TRA, DUA | The claim has closed and the protest window of the last statement has passed |
| Reimbursing Governmental Employer — Dollar-for-Dollar | 1 | UCFE, UCX, TRA, DUA | The claim has closed and the protest window of the last statement has passed |

The noncharged programs are Unemployment Compensation for Federal Employees (UCFE), Unemployment Compensation for Ex-Servicemembers (UCX), Trade Readjustment Allowances (TRA) and Disaster Unemployment Assistance (DUA).

## Total charged

The total charged on a position is the benefits charged to that employer on that claim: the charges posted from each payment, less credits for relief, recovered overpayments, cancelled payments and appeal reversals. It is kept in US dollars.

## Position statuses

| Status | What it shows |
|---|---|
| Noticed | The notice of claim has been mailed and no response is on the position yet |
| Responded | The employer's separation and wage response has been received |
| Chargeable | The position carries charges without relief |
| Protest pending | A written protest of the charges on a statement is awaiting decision |
| Relieved | The employer has been relieved of the charges |
| Closed | The position takes no further charges or protests |

## Basis Q&A

**Can one employer hold more than one Employer Benefit Charging position on the same claim?** No. Every class allows 1 position per employer account per claim.

**Does a payment under the UCX program charge a former employer's position?** No. A UCX payment, like a UCFE, TRA or DUA payment, never opens or charges a position, in every class.
